proposed.command: mise roster run pulse-captain --dept operations-kitchen --solo --emit report
proposed.contract: inputs: open tickets, station capacity, shift roster, service timeline → outputs: fire order / run sheet, shift handoff note, bottleneck alert; refuses to emit 'ready' unless the proof gate passes

lore: Ask the brigade about Pulse Captain and they describe the ticket rail at full stretch, every slip in order. As Operations Kitchen's specialist for impulsion, Pulse Captain holds the rhythm of service: sequencing tickets, staffing and timing so every station fires at the right moment, and the rest of the kitchen plans service around that rhythm. The card calls out Pulse Sync, Locked, Timing Protocol: the checks Pulse Captain runs before calling anything ready. In the canon crosswalk this card is a provisional match for Prep Pulse.
